Every test whose path reaches `pymysql.connect` (query execution, or the preflight database probe through `serve`, `validate --check-db` or `run_preflight`) supplies its own fake. [tests/unit/test_cli.py:28] — fix the code, or have the issue author amend this criterion

Criterion 3 requires the default `pytest -q` run to fail if any call reaches the real `pymysql.connect`, via a session-wide replacement that records each call and raises, checked even when the code under test caught the error. The head view has no such mechanism. tests/conftest.py (read in full) has only an env scrub, an agent-singleton reset, stub_agent_send_message and collect_ignore. The only other conftests (tests/unit/conftest.py, tests/integration/conftest.py) contain no pymysql.connect replacement. Grep for session-scoped fixtures, pytest_configure, pytest_sessionfinish and pytest_plugins in tests/, conftest.py and pyproject.toml found nothing. pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] adds no plugin or guard.
